provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2026 men's Frozen Four at T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas, as played: the national semifinals on 9 April (Wisconsin beat North Dakota 2-1, Denver beat Michigan 4-3 in double overtime) and the National Championship on 11 April (Denver beat Wisconsin 2-1). Each event is one round, one game for each team. The field is every skater in the game's box score, positions (forward or defense) from ESPN's box scores and birth countries from ESPN's athlete records; ranking is the skater's 2025-26 Power Play total before the Frozen Four (2 per goal + assists + shots on goal), from the school's season statistics less the skater's Frozen Four games. Each box score (goals, assists, shots on goal) is from ESPN, cross-checked skater by skater against College Hockey News, which agree on every line; College Hockey News lists Denver's Brady Milburn as a dressed extra with no line in both games, where ESPN lists him with no goal, assist or shot, so he has an empty line. A skater with no goal, assist or shot in a game has an empty line.
